p.s: We introduce SparseRoute, a mixture-of-experts layer that routes each token to a single expert.
On the FLORES-200 benchmark SparseRoute improves BLEU by 2.1 points over a dense Transformer baseline while using 30% fewer training FLOPs.
Code is available at https://github.com/example/sparseroute.
Recent work has shown that careful design of the training objective matters as much as model size.
We study this question under a controlled compute budget and report results averaged over several random seeds so that differences can be attributed to the method rather than to noise.

First, we propose a routing rule that needs no auxiliary load-balancing loss.
Second, we evaluate it on FLORES-200 and WMT 2014 English-German.
Third, we release code and trained checkpoints.

p.s: Each token representation x is sent to the expert with the highest router score, and the layer output is the expert output scaled by the router probability:
